topic: Intrinsic and Extrinsic Spoilage Assessment Sequence
questionText:
Arrange the sequential investigative steps to evaluate why a packaged food product experienced premature spoilage:
(A) Inspect packaging integrity for seal leaks, pinholes, or vacuum failure
(B) Measure intrinsic food factors: moisture content, water activity (aw), and pH
(C) Evaluate extrinsic storage conditions: ambient temperature, relative humidity, and light exposure
(D) Perform microbiological culture and biochemical assay to identify specific spoilage pathogens

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: A, B, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: B, A, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A, C, B, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: D, B, C, A
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Spoilage investigation follows: pack integrity (A) -> intrinsic parameters (pH, aw) (B) -> extrinsic factors (temp/light) (C) -> microbial culture (D).
Hence Option D is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.
